faqs.question: How many packs are in a Pokémon booster box?
faqs.answer: English main-line Pokémon booster boxes hold 36 packs of 10 cards. Japanese main-line booster boxes hold 30 packs of 5 cards. Special sets and older products can differ.

faqs.question: How many packs are in a Japanese Pokémon booster box?
faqs.answer: A Japanese main-line Pokémon booster box typically holds 30 packs of 5 cards, for 150 cards in total. Some special sets are sold in different pack counts.

faqs.question: How many cards are in a Pokémon booster pack?
faqs.answer: English main-line Pokémon booster packs contain 10 cards. Japanese main-line packs contain 5 cards. Special sets can use different counts.

faqs.question: What is an Elite Trainer Box?
faqs.answer: An Elite Trainer Box is a sealed Pokémon TCG product that includes booster packs plus card sleeves, dice, condition markers, a player's guide and a storage box.

faqs.question: What is a booster bundle?
faqs.answer: A booster bundle is a sealed bundle of booster packs sold without the extras of an Elite Trainer Box. Recent Pokémon booster bundles commonly contain six packs.

faqs.question: What is a booster box case?
faqs.answer: A case is a sealed factory carton holding multiple booster boxes. Pokémon cases commonly hold six boxes and One Piece cases commonly hold twelve displays, so always check the listing.

faqs.question: Do you sell single cards or only sealed product?
faqs.answer: PokéStore Direct sells factory-sealed product only, including booster boxes, Elite Trainer Boxes, booster bundles, sealed cases and accessories. We do not sell single cards.

faqs.question: Are PokéStore Direct products factory sealed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every item we sell is factory-sealed, and we inspect the seals, corners and edges before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do you check a sealed box for reseals?
faqs.answer: We check for a single continuous shrink-wrap seam, factory vent holes, printed Pokéball logos, weight against a reference box, and print quality. Three independent checks must agree before a box is listed.

faqs.question: How can I tell if a Pokémon booster box is resealed?
faqs.answer: Look for a second or angled shrink-wrap seam, missing factory vent holes, missing printed Pokéball logos, tape residue, or a weight noticeably lighter than a known box. Modern factory wrap has a single seam per panel and small vent holes.

faqs.question: Can you weigh Pokémon packs to find hits?
faqs.answer: Weighing is unreliable on modern Pokémon product because most packs contain a reverse holo or better and pack weights overlap. Buying factory-sealed product avoids the risk of searched or weighed stock.

faqs.question: Is it better to buy Japanese or English Pokémon cards?
faqs.answer: Japanese product is often cheaper to open and is prized for print quality and exclusive artwork, while English product has the deeper international buyer pool and higher resale on the same artwork. Many collectors buy Japanese to open and English to hold.

faqs.question: Why are Japanese Pokémon cards cheaper than English?
faqs.answer: Japanese sets are printed in larger volume relative to domestic demand, which keeps unit prices lower. Growing export demand has been narrowing the gap.

faqs.question: Are Japanese Pokémon cards worth more than English?
faqs.answer: Not as a blanket rule. English cards generally fetch higher secondary prices for the same artwork because the buyer pool is deeper, while specific Japanese cards and exclusive prints can command a premium.

faqs.question: Are Pokémon booster boxes a good investment?
faqs.answer: Out-of-print sealed product has historically appreciated, while sets still in distribution tend to trade near retail. Returns are not guaranteed and vary by set.

faqs.question: Does Pokémon reprint booster boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pokémon reprints popular sets, so product still being printed tends to trade near retail while out-of-print product can appreciate.

faqs.question: How should I store sealed Pokémon product?
faqs.answer: Aim for a stable 40 to 50 percent relative humidity at 18 to 24 degrees Celsius, keep product out of direct sunlight, store boxes no more than two high, and avoid attics, garages and basements.

faqs.question: Does humidity damage Pokémon cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paper takes on and gives off moisture as conditions change; below about 30 percent relative humidity cardstock becomes brittle, and above 60 percent it risks mould, warping and chemical breakdown.

faqs.question: When did One Piece OP-15 release?
faqs.answer: OP-15, Adventure on Kami's Island, launched worldwide on 3 April 2026. It covers the Skypiea arc.

faqs.question: What changed on the One Piece restricted list in April 2026?
faqs.answer: From 10 April 2026 in North America, Europe, Latin America and Oceania, OP07-115 I Re-Quasar Helllp!! and EB04-058 Borsalino cannot be played in the same deck. Each card remains legal on its own.

faqs.question: What is Weiss Schwarz?
faqs.answer: Weiss Schwarz is a Bushiroad trading card game built around licensed anime and video-game properties. A deck contains 50 cards, including exactly 8 climax cards.

faqs.question: How many packs are in a Weiss Schwarz display?
faqs.answer: English Weiss Schwarz displays commonly hold 12 packs of 8 cards, but the count varies by release and some sets use 9-card packs. Check the product page for the exact count.

faqs.question: What is a Weiss Schwarz trial deck?
faqs.answer: A trial deck is a ready-to-play 50-card Weiss Schwarz deck. English trial decks commonly retail between $25 and $30, and two trial decks give you a legal game for two players.

faqs.question: Is One Piece TCG worth collecting?
faqs.answer: The One Piece Card Game has both a competitive player base and a collector market, and short-printed manga alternate-art Secret Rares hold value. English displays contain 24 packs.

faqs.question: Is PSA, CGC or BGS better for grading Pokémon cards?
faqs.answer: PSA slabs generally outsell CGC and BGS on identical cards, while CGC costs less per card and BGS includes subgrades. The better choice depends on the card's value and whether you are grading to sell or to keep.

faqs.question: How much does PSA grading cost?
faqs.answer: In PSA's February 2026 update, the entry Value tier is $32.99 per card, with Value Plus at $49.99 and Value Max at $64.99. Cheaper tiers have opened and closed through the year.

faqs.question: How much does CGC grading cost?
faqs.answer: CGC's published card tiers start at $17 per card for Bulk with a 25-card minimum, with Economy at $20, Standard at $55 and Express at $100. Members receive 10 to 20 percent off.

faqs.question: What is inside the 30th Celebration set?
faqs.answer: The 30th Celebration set shipped worldwide on 16 September 2026 with five all-foil cards per pack, 161 cards plus a 30-card Classic Collection, and a new Futuristic Rare tier. A Classic Collection card appears in roughly 1 in 10 packs.
